'''Scott White''' (also known as Scotty White) was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 21 from Tyngsboro, MA.<ref name="sm-fan" /> The slot was retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

[[File:Scott White DragonCon 2010.jpg|thumb|right|220px|White at DragonCon 2010]]

He also took part in the [[Star Trek CCG]] First Contact demos.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

== In their own words ==

<blockquote>
Star Trek Customizable Card Game is what drew me to CCGs
                      to start with. Later, I began playing Star Wars CCG the
                      day it hit a local shop. From there, I began running my
                      own tournaments for the fun of it. Since that time I have
                      taught a number of people how to play and some are among
                      the best in New England.

 My greatest contribution has been to provide as professional
                      a tournament experience as possible for the players. I have
                      been privileged to host the last 3 Star Wars CCG Kashyyyk
                      Regional qualifiers, as well as a Star Trek CCG Regional.
                      I participated in the First Contact demos and have demo'd
                      product at all the Star Wars: Special Edition releases at
                      local movie theaters.

In addition to CCGs, I like country music, camping, hunting,
                      target shooting and high-powered model rocketry. Favorite
                      actors include Harrison Ford, John Wayne and Clint Eastwood.
                      The future of Star Wars CCG never looked better, and I 'm
                      glad to be a part of it!<ref name="decsq-prof" />
</blockquote>
